Layla Costa
layla.costa@example.com | Louisville, KY
Layla Costa has 4 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Backend Engineer at Driftwood Software (2024-2026), where they
applied distributed-systems patterns to scale the platform to 104K concurrent
users. Before that, Software Engineer I at Slate Labs (2022-2024). Education:
B.S. Information Systems, University of Texas at Dallas, 2021. Core skills:
Redis, TypeScript, GraphQL, AWS, Distributed systems, CI/CD, Node.js, RabbitMQ,
Terraform.
